title: Wuying-Browser-Agent: Real-World Centric Fundamental Long-Horizon Browser Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.17319v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Browser agents perform well on short, clean demonstrations, but real deployment is fundamentally different: agents must sustain dozens of decisions on live websites while recovering from mistakes and navigating complex UIs. We argue that closing this gap requires alignment at every level of the pipeline, including execution, supervision, optimization, and evaluation, rather than scale alone. We present Wuying-Browser-Agent, a unified framework that addresses each of these levels. A structured browser harness provides stable execution primitives and decision-oriented context management. Reflection and UI-specialized Curriculum SFT (RUIC-SFT) explicitly trains on recovery trajectories and complex-UI interactions. Divergence-Aware Online GRPO (DAO-GRPO) improves long-horizon credit assignment through potential-based reward shaping and divergence-aware step weighting. Finally, we introduce BrowserBench, a bilingual real-web benchmark of 350

translated_title: 吴影浏览器代理：面向真实世界的核心长时程浏览器代理
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.17319v1 公告类型：新。浏览器代理在简短、清晰的演示中表现良好，但实际部署根本不同：代理必须在实时网站上维持数十次决策，同时从错误中恢复并导航复杂的用户界面。我们认为，缩小这一差距需要在管道的每个层面进行对齐，包括执行、监督、优化和评估，而不仅仅是规模扩展。我们提出了吴影浏览器代理，一个统一框架，解决了这些层面中的每一个。一个结构化的浏览器工具集提供稳定的执行原语和面向决策的上下文管理。反思和UI专用课程SFT（RUIC-SFT）明确训练恢复轨迹和复杂UI交互。发散感知在线GRPO（DAO-GRPO）通过基于势的奖励塑形和发散感知步骤加权，改善了长时程信用分配。最后，我们引入了BrowserBench，一个包含350个双语真实网页基准。
tldr: 本文提出吴影浏览器代理，通过结构化工具集、反思与UI专用课程SFT、发散感知在线GRPO及BrowserBench基准，全面对齐执行、监督、优化和评估，以提升长时程真实浏览器任务性能。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Wuying-Browser-Agent, which aligns execution, supervision, optimization, and evaluation via a structured harness, reflection-based curriculum SFT, divergence-aware online GRPO, and the BrowserBench benchmark to improve long-horizon real-world browser task performance.
